scope: Public TOFA launch, installed bundled engine, owned loopback providers and isolated fixture homes

origin_contract.consistency: Repeated encoded thread/turn/role fields must agree; duplicate review JSON fields are rejected
origin_contract.binding: Immutable originating inference service per thread and turn, bounded to 4096 retained entries per launch
origin_contract.token_factory: Configured Guardian, including an explicit override
origin_contract.native: Reviewer selected by actual engine and validated against launch native catalog; no assumed reviewer model
origin_contract.native_policy_shape: Leading developer additional_tools/functions inspection inventory followed by developer policy and exact approval schema; original native request bytes forwarded
origin_contract.observer: Actual Python Observer independently records Main origins, recognizes measured review contracts and counts every forwarded engine review attempt

observed_behavior: Token Factory allow and deny enforce execution outcomes through native approval engine
Native allow after inspection and native deny enforce execution outcomes
Pending review remains on originating service through Main selection changes and another concurrent conversation
Native inspection continuation dispatched after selection change retains original native review service
Subsequent Main turn follows explicitly changed selection
Missing, unobserved, conflicting or malformed origin/role/policy/inventory/schema metadata cannot execute an action
Unavailable Guardian and upstream503 do not substitute a reviewer or bypass execution gates
503 triggers engine-originated review retries; the adapter adds none; actual Observer request budget2 forwards only Main1 plus review1 then stops
Review credentials remain service-specific and launch inference authorization never reaches either upstream
Inference capability and legacy inference bearer cannot invoke review cancellation control
Cancellation control503 returns explicit RPC failure and terminates the owned engine before pending approval can authorize execution
Ordinary direct-native openai history resumes, interrupts and continues without entering candidate native routing; concurrent routed work remains available

cancellation_regression.red: An actual native review remained connected after parent turn/interrupt, then a late allow executed the owned marker command despite the parent reporting interrupted
cancellation_regression.fix: Existing settings relay acknowledges exact thread+turn invalidation using independent control authorization before forwarding turn/interrupt. Origin cancellation synchronously invalidates bound review contexts. Cancelled origin tombstones cannot revive through late Main or review requests
cancellation_regression.green: Both Token Factory and native pending review cancellation prevent execution; late native allow on disconnected review cannot create the marker; no policy result is rewritten
cancellation_regression.direct_native: Unknown exact IDs receive bounded tombstones and ordinary native interrupt is forwarded unchanged; direct native history is not reclassified as routed work

qualification_limits: Synthetic local upstreams and fake credentials; no live provider or paid inference
No installed Desktop launch, sign-in mutation, shared settings write, plugin mutation or preview qualification
Actual Desktop account/plugin preservation and native preview gates remain separate
Production guard and integration-branch restriction remain active

If independent cancellation control is unavailable, the relay fails closed by terminating its owned engine even for an unseen direct-native turn; absence of adapter provenance is not treated as proof of native service

Owned protocol fixtures explicitly disable plugin initialization using features.plugins=false; they do not qualify plugin preservation. An earlier run raced a background plugins-clone writer during cleanup; external marketplace discovery may have occurred without real credentials. Production and actual Desktop qualification keep plugins enabled

validation.broader_regression_note: All behavioral assertions passed; one background plugin-clone TempDir cleanup failed. Fixture-only plugin initialization disabled and entire affected protocol suite rerun successfully. Original failure retained.
